title: Loki
whyItMatters: The point where the MCU's single, protected timeline breaks open into a multiverse.

events.text: The Time Variance Authority (TVA) is revealed to prune branching timelines to protect a single 'Sacred Timeline'.
events.citation: Loki S1 E1, "Glorious Purpose"

events.text: He Who Remains, who controls the TVA, is killed by Sylvie. The timeline immediately begins to branch uncontrollably.
events.citation: Loki S1 E6, "For All Time. Always." — the Citadel at the End of Time

events.text: He Who Remains warns that his death will unleash variants of himself who are far more dangerous.
events.citation: Loki S1 E6, "For All Time. Always."

superseded.note: The Kang storyline this set up was later dropped; Avengers: The Kang Dynasty became Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Spider-Man: No Way Home
whyItMatters: The first time characters from other film universes cross into the MCU on screen.

events.text: A corrupted spell from Doctor Strange pulls people who know Peter Parker's identity in from other universes.
events.citation: Spider-Man: No Way Home — the Sanctum spell scene

events.text: Spider-Man variants played by Tobey Maguire and Andrew Garfield appear, establishing that earlier non-MCU film universes exist inside the multiverse.
events.citation: Spider-Man: No Way Home — third act

title: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness
whyItMatters: Names and explains incursions: the collisions between universes that sit at the heart of Marvel's multiverse endgame in the comics.

events.text: An incursion is described as two universes colliding, with one destroying the other. Earth-838 is shown to have suffered one.
events.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness — Earth-838 sequences

events.text: A variant of Reed Richards (John Krasinski) appears as a member of Earth-838's Illuminati and is killed by Wanda.
events.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness — Illuminati sequence

events.text: Clea tells Strange that he caused an incursion and must help fix it.
events.citation: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness — mid-credits scene

title: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania
whyItMatters: Built the Kang-led saga that Doomsday ultimately replaced, which makes it essential context for what changed.

events.text: Kang the Conqueror is introduced as an exiled variant in the Quantum Realm.
events.citation: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania

events.text: A Council of Kangs gathers, signalling a multiversal war led by Kang variants.
events.citation: Ant-Man and the Wasp: Quantumania — mid-credits scene

superseded.note: Marvel moved away from Kang as the saga's central villain; the planned Kang Dynasty film became Avengers: Doomsday.

title: Loki
whyItMatters: Leaves Loki as the being who holds the multiverse's timelines together, making him a structural part of the multiverse.

events.text: Loki takes the seat at the End of Time and binds the branching timelines into a tree-like structure, sustaining the multiverse.
events.citation: Loki S2 E6, "Glorious Purpose"

title: Deadpool & Wolverine
whyItMatters: Brings the Fox X-Men universe into MCU continuity and explains how a universe can die when it loses its 'anchor being'.

events.text: The TVA explains that a universe depends on an 'anchor being'. When that being dies, the universe slowly ends.
events.citation: Deadpool & Wolverine — TVA sequence

events.text: The Void is shown as a dumping ground for pruned characters, including figures from earlier Fox Marvel films.
events.citation: Deadpool & Wolverine — the Void

title: Captain America: Brave New World
whyItMatters: Positions Sam Wilson as Captain America and the person who will rebuild the Avengers.

events.text: Sam Wilson commits to rebuilding the Avengers.
events.citation: Captain America: Brave New World — closing act

title: Thunderbolts*
whyItMatters: Creates a rival 'New Avengers' team and ends by bringing the Fantastic Four's world into contact with Earth-616.

events.text: Valentina Allegra de Fontaine publicly presents the team as "The New Avengers".
events.citation: Thunderbolts* — closing scene

events.text: A spacecraft from another dimension is detected entering Earth's atmosphere.
events.citation: Thunderbolts* — post-credits scene

events.text: The spacecraft is the Fantastic Four's ship, arriving from their universe.
events.citation: Thunderbolts* — post-credits scene
events.note: The ship design matches The Fantastic Four: First Steps. The scene does not name its occupants.

title: The Fantastic Four: First Steps
whyItMatters: Introduces Reed, Sue, Johnny, Ben and baby Franklin on Earth-828, then gives Doctor Doom his first on-screen appearance.

events.text: The Fantastic Four live on Earth-828, a separate universe from the main MCU (Earth-616).
events.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps

events.text: Galactus targets the Richards' newborn son Franklin because of the child's extraordinary power.
events.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — main plot

events.text: Years later, Sue finds a hooded figure sitting with Franklin. A Doom mask is visible, but the figure's face is not shown.
events.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — post-credits scene

events.text: An end card states that the Fantastic Four will return in Avengers: Doomsday.
events.citation: The Fantastic Four: First Steps — end credits

title: Avengers: Doomsday
whyItMatters: Heroes from three universes, the Avengers, X-Men and Fantastic Four, together on screen for the first time, against Doctor Doom.

events.text: Heroes from three distinct universes are set on a deadly collision course and face an existential threat.
events.citation: marvel.com, "Everything to Know About Avengers: Doomsday" (5 Nov 2026)

events.text: The Avengers, X-Men and Fantastic Four assemble on screen together for the first time.
events.citation: marvel.com (23 Nov 2026)

events.text: Robert Downey Jr. plays Victor von Doom. Joe and Anthony Russo direct from a script by Stephen McFeely.
events.citation: marvel.com; SDCC Hall H, 27 July 2024

events.text: Doom: "All of you have lived stolen lives, now you must give them back."
events.citation: Final trailer, quoted by The Hollywood Reporter (23 Nov 2026)

events.text: Two planets loom over Earth.
events.citation: Final trailer, as described by Gizmodo, Screen Rant and others
events.note: Widely read as an incursion. The film has not yet named it as one.

events.text: Doom commands Sentinels against the Avengers and X-Men.
events.citation: Final trailer, as reported by Variety

events.text: Avengers: Secret Wars follows on 17 December 2027.
events.citation: marvel.com (5 Nov 2026)

title: Avengers: Endgame
whyItMatters: Marvel traces Doomsday back to Endgame's final moments: Steve Rogers choosing a life with Peggy Carter.

events.text: The Avengers travel through time to take the Infinity Stones from the past and reverse the Snap.
events.citation: Avengers: Endgame: the Time Heist

events.text: Steve Rogers returns the Stones, then stays in the past to live his life with Peggy Carter.
events.citation: Avengers: Endgame: final act

events.text: An elderly Steve passes his shield to Sam Wilson.
events.citation: Avengers: Endgame: final act

events.text: Doom's "stolen lives" accusation targets heroes whose lives were changed by these events.
events.citation: Avengers: Doomsday final trailer; press readings (SYFY, Variety)
events.note: Press widely reads the trailer as tying the Time Heist to the incursions. Marvel has not stated it.

title: Avengers Endgame: Encore
whyItMatters: Endgame returns with new footage that reframes Steve's ending as the start of Doomsday.

events.text: Avengers: Endgame returns to theaters as Avengers Endgame: Encore, with an exclusive look at Doomsday.
events.citation: marvel.com; The Hollywood Reporter; Deadline

events.text: "We sort of played one beat past where Steve Rogers' story ended with Peggy Carter… that's where Doomsday is born." (Anthony Russo)
events.citation: marvel.com, "Watch the Final Avengers: Doomsday Trailer" (23 Nov 2026)

events.text: A new scene reveals that Steve and Peggy have a son.
events.citation: Avengers Endgame: Encore, as reported by Variety (23 Nov 2026)
events.note: An editor still needs to verify the timestamp. The son's name is not confirmed.

events.text: A TVA scene shows an incursion between Earth-10005 and Earth-1127.
events.citation: As reported by TheWrap and Reactor
